plugins.name: project-init
plugins.description: Initialize a new Claude project for DSL or any analogous research lab — scans uploaded skill files, checks for the project index and reference docs, and configures the project environment.

plugins.name: project-updater
plugins.description: Check an already-initialized DSL project for drift between its declared index and actual files, and refresh index.md.

plugins.name: output-style
plugins.description: Standing conversational style instruction for DSL project sessions — tone, formatting, and fabrication-prevention rules applied continuously, not deliverable formatting.

plugins.name: output-evaluator
plugins.description: Evaluate the quality of any DSL research deliverable — memos, decks, guidebooks, project docs, or Claude skills — against DSL's standard, with an intake check before evaluating.

plugins.name: ai-energy-emissions-report
plugins.description: Estimate the electricity consumption and GHG emissions of AI inference from Claude session token data, and produce a DSL-branded PDF report using the Watershed Activity Tier framework.

plugins.name: external-research-assistant
plugins.description: Conduct structured external web research with cited findings, source evaluation, uncertainty flags, and a research gaps section, for sustainability, ESG, and policy research.

plugins.name: figures
plugins.description: Guidance for creating figures, charts, maps, tables, or data visualizations for DSL work, tailored to the researcher's data, goal, and intended deliverable.

plugins.name: excel
plugins.description: Create a new Excel spreadsheet (.xlsx) — trackers, Gantt-style project timelines, budget sheets, or data tables — following DSL formatting standards.

plugins.name: memo
plugins.description: Create a professional DSL memo or memorandum as a polished Word (.docx) file following DSL's structured, section-based memo conventions.

plugins.name: technical-bulletin
plugins.description: Scaffold and generate a DSL technical bulletin as a branded .pptx file, through an intake, structure-confirmation, markdown-scaffold, and generation sequence.

plugins.name: work-recorder
plugins.description: Open and maintain a DSL research fellow's session ledger — which chats belong to which task, what each session produced, and whether the task finished.

plugins.name: ai-usage-assessment-per-chat
plugins.description: Assess how a person worked with Claude in one specific chat and render a visual AI Usage Assessment scorecard scoring the four competencies of AI fluency, with growth coaching.
